instruction.text: Find all the electrical appliances in Phil’s bedroom.

atoms.a: Are the electrical appliances in safe places?
What is wrong with the placement of the phone?
b: ++It is on the bed, which could cause an electrical fire.
It is on the bed, which could affect Phil’s sleep schedule.

atoms.a: What is wrong with the placement of the hairdryer?
b: It is too far away from the bed, so Phil cannot reach it.
++It is too close to the fish tank and could get wet.

instruction.text: Find the electrical appliance in Talia’s Kitchen.

atoms.a: Is the blender in a safe place?
b: ++Yes, it is a safe distance away from the sink.
No, it is right next to the sink.

atoms.a: Talia washes some dishes and, without drying her hands, goes to plug the blender in. Is this safe?
b: ++No, she should dry her hands thoroughly before using the blender.

atoms.a: What could happen to Talia if she uses the blender with wet hands?
b: She could forget to add an ingredient to the mixture.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the dangerous uses of electrical appliances.

atoms.a: Raj is making his breakfast. He washes his hands and turns on the toaster with wet hands. His toast gets stuck in the toaster, so he uses a metal fork to get it out.

instruction.text: What should Raj have done? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Raj is making his breakfast. He washes his hands and ((++dries_them_thoroughly shakes_most_of_the_water_off)) before turning on the toaster. His toast gets stuck in the toaster, so he ((uses_a_metal_knife ++unplugs_it_and_turns_it_upside_down)) to get it out.
